question: To which of the following incarnations of Vishnu is Dhanuyatra of Odisha's Bargah district dedicated?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lord Krishna.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Dhanuyatra of Odisha's Bargah district is dedicated to Lord Krishna.
 
• In the town of Bargarh in western Odisha, this Dhanu Yatra is performed.
 
• It is considered the biggest open-air theatrical performance in Asia.
 
• This is Held either in the month of December or January.
 
• This festival is organised to celebrate the Independence and victory of the good over the evil.
